candidateAudit.title: From the stars of Phuket to the heart of Vienna. 🇹🇭🇦🇹 A little taste of Southern Thailand has arrived at Anantara Palais Hansen Vienna! 🍜 For this special two-month pop-up, th
candidateAudit.text: From the stars of Phuket to the heart of Vienna. 🇹🇭🇦🇹 A little taste of Southern Thailand has arrived at Anantara Palais Hansen Vienna! 🍜 For this special two-month pop-up, the team from DARA Cuisine at Anantara Layan Phuket Resort traveled all the way from Thailand, bringing their signature flavors and culinary traditions to Vienna. We learned that DARA means “stars” in Thai — a fitting name for a restaurant that not only celebrates Southern Thai cuisine but also features an Observatory Deck at its Phuket resort, where guests can enjoy guided stargazing through a telescope. ⭐ Our dinner was a beautiful introduction to the region’s vibrant flavors, from scallops served in betel leaves and delicate cod fish in aromatic coconut broth to Pad Thai with lobster and salmon roe, finishing with a delicious taro coconut crème brûlée. A special experience made even more memorable by meeting Head Chef Hongz and her team, who brought a little piece of Phuket to Vienna. It’s clearly been a hit in Vienna, with reservations already becoming hard to come by! If you’re hoping to experience this special culinary collaboration, I’d recommend booking ahead before the pop-up wraps up On December 13! #dolceandmasala # dara.thaicuisine.vienna #viennafoodie anantaravienna #viennarestaurants

candidateAudit.text: Hey, I’m Lisa! 👋🏼🤎 Just a Vienna girl with a big love for amazing food, cozy cafés, delicious matcha & discovering new favorite places around this beautiful city! ☕️🍵🥐 When I’m not teaching, you’ll probably find me exploring Vienna’s pretty streets, trying a restaurant that’s been on my list forever, enjoying a little coffee date or taking way too many pictures along the way. 🏛️📸✨ I’ve always loved finding beautiful places and sharing my favorite discoveries, so I thought – why not turn it into my own little Vienna diary? 🤎 Here you’ll find honest food reviews, cute cafés, coffee & matcha recommendations, hidden gems, travel adventures & little pieces of my everyday life. Nothing perfectly planned or overly staged – just me enjoying the little things, discovering new places & sharing what genuinely makes me happy! 🫶🏼 I’m still at the beginning of this little journey, with big dreams, lots of ideas & so many memories waiting to be made. 🥹✨ A little bit of Vienna, a little bit of me & hopefully lots of delicious adventures ahead! If you love good food, pretty cafés & exploring Vienna as much as I do, I think you’ll feel right at home here! 👀🤎 Follow wiener.lisa_ and come along for all the cozy coffee dates, honest recommendations & hidden gems still waiting to be discovered! ✨ #ViennaFoodGuide #ViennaEats #ViennaCafes #ViennaCoffeeSpots #WienLiebe
